Review Questions 
1 . How does protein intake contribute to growth and development during childhood? 
a. Maintains digestive function 
b. Influences nutrient absorption 
c. Plays an anabolic role similar to that of growth hormone 
d. Mediates levels of growth hormone 
2 . Which of the following foods supplies micronutrients that decrease inflammation? 
a. Kale 
b. Sourdough bread 
c. Beef 
d. White rice 
3 . Medications given to older adults to stimulate appetite target which hormone? 
a. Ghrelin 
b. Thyroid-stimulating hormone 
c. Insulin 
d. Cholecystokinin 
4 . Which of the following is a good food choice for a client with Hashimoto’s thyroiditis who needs to consume 
iodine-rich foods? 
a. Leafy green vegetables 
b. Fish 
c. Citrus fruits 
d. Whole grains 
5 . The nurse is providing dietary education for a client with diabetes. The client asks why their sodium intake 
should be limited. What is the best response from the nurse? 
a. “Lowering your sodium intake can decrease your blood glucose level.” 
b. “A low-sodium diet can decrease inflammation in the body.” 
c. “Sodium-controlled diets can lower your elevated risk for developing cardiovascular disease and 
hypertension.” 
d. “Adding less salt to your food can decrease the food’s glycemic index.” 
6 . What is the recommended daily intake of saturated fats for individuals with diabetes? 
a. Less than 5% 
b. Less than 10% 
c. Less than 15% 
d. Less than 20%
